text.p: Cellular Communications of Puerto Rico Inc said on Thursday it and it wholly-owned operating subsidiary CCPR Services Inc planned to restructure into a new entity.

Cellular Communications shareholders would become shareholders in the new company, it said. Cellular and CCPR Services would also repay all outstanding amounts under their existing bank credit facility, it said.
CCPR Services would make a cash payment to Cellular Communications, and it would acquire a precentage of Cellular's interest in the San Juan Cellular Telephone Co, the company said.
The new company would use funds it received from the restructuring, and other capital resources, to pursue opportunities outside Puerto Rico, Cellular said.

CCPR Services would raise money needed to complete the restructuring by raising gross proceeds of about $175 million from a private placement of senior subordinated notes due 2007. This would be completed later this month, it said.
